description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Employee entity in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing employee creation, nationality assignment, and name trimming functionalities.

classes.name: EmployeeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing the Employee entity and its related functionalities, including nationality handling and name formatting.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating specific tables to ensure a clean state before each test.

methods.name: testEmployeeEntityWithNationality
methods.description: Tests setting and retrieving the Employee's nationality, verifying associations and data integrity.

methods.name: testEmployeeDetailsTrim
methods.description: Verifies that employee names are correctly trimmed and concatenated in the full name decorator.
